title: Press Kit
subtitle: Everything you need to write about or make videos of SouMoster games. All assets may be used for editorial coverage, reviews, and let's-play videos.
aboutP1: {site} is an independent Android game developer building fun, addictive, high-quality games with simple controls and a polished feel. The studio's Hopper series started with Road Hopper, live on Google Play, followed by Bank Hopper, a one-thumb bank heist arcade game, also live on Google Play.
aboutP2: Time Hopper, a seven-era time-travel runner, is in Google Play Closed Testing. Space Hopper, an eight-planet hop across the galaxy, and Arena Legends, the studio's first action game, are in development. Trailers, gameplay, and developer videos are on YouTube at {handle}.
needMoreText: For review builds, interview requests, high-resolution assets, or early access to games in testing, email <email>{address}</email>.
